newsitem.title: MEXICO: Body dug up at ranch of Raul Salinas.
newsitem.headline: Body dug up at ranch of Raul Salinas.

text.p: Mexican investigators said they dug up a body on the ranch of former President Carlos Salinas' brother Raul on Wednesday that may help them prove he ordered the 1994 murder of a top ruling party politician.

Investigators said the corpse may be the remains of Manuel Munoz Rocha, a former politician who was missing shortly after he allegedly helped Raul organise the murder of Jose Francisco Ruiz Massieu, secretary-general of the Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI), in September 1994.
"This is a discovery which is important for us," chief investigator Pablo Chapa Bezanilla said. "If it is Manuel Munoz Rocha, then this is important for the investigations."

Police were ordered late on Tuesday to begin tearing up the 20-acre (eight hectares) "El Encanto" ranch just outside Mexico City, using a bulldozer and sniffer dogs to search for the remains of Munoz Rocha.

Reporters saw detectives leaving the ranch holding a skull which police said had been split in half with a powerful blow. Forensic experts were to examine the remains later to determine whether they belonged to Munoz Rocha.
Investigators suspect the conspirators who organised the murder may have killed Munoz Rocha afterward to cover their tracks.
Munoz Rocha was last seen the day after the crime, Sept. 29, 1994, when he went to a meeting at a Mexico City restaurant with Raul Salinas, a witness has said.
Raul has been in jail since February 1995 on charges of ordering the murder and is also being investigated by Mexican authorities for corruption and money laundering.
He denies any wrongdoing or even friendship with Munoz Rocha and investigators have so far had a tough time finding hard evidence linking him to the crime.
The killing of Ruiz Massieu, a rising star in the long-ruling PRI, stunned Mexico and was part of a series of events that year that eventually led to the disastrous peso crash in December 1994.
Ruiz Massieu was shot dead outside a Mexico City hotel by a gunman who later said he was forced to commit the crime after being blackmailed by an alleged agent of Raul's.

The motives for his murder are still not clear. Journalists have suggested they could include a dispute over drug money, a political row or a family argument over Ruiz Massieu's bitter divorce years ago from Salinas's sister Adriana.
